from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyCashBalance(BaseModel):
    """Beginning Balance of Cash and Cash Equivalents from one company's financial statement."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as reported in the filing")
    balance_value: float | None = Field(description="The reported beginning balance amount as written in the filing")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="How the amount is expressed: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    date: str | None = Field(description="The date of the balance as reported")
    line_label: str | None = Field(description="The line-item label as written in the filing")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt from the financial statement")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_balance_entries: list[CompanyCashBalance]
